parameters.query:
INSERT INTO resource_demand (
    resource_id,
    project_id,
    week_start_date,
    activity_name,
    planned_hours,
    activity_priority,
    critical_path
)
VALUES (
    $1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7
)
ON CONFLICT (
    resource_id,
    project_id,
    week_start_date,
    activity_name
)
DO UPDATE SET
    planned_hours = EXCLUDED.planned_hours,
    activity_priority = EXCLUDED.activity_priority,
    critical_path = EXCLUDED.critical_path,
    updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
RETURNING *;

WITH utilization AS (
    SELECT
        rc.resource_id,
        rc.week_start_date,
        rc.available_hours,
        COALESCE(SUM(rd.planned_hours), 0) AS demand_hours,

        ROUND(
            CASE
                WHEN rc.available_hours > 0
                THEN (
                    COALESCE(SUM(rd.planned_hours), 0)
                    / rc.available_hours
                ) * 100
                ELSE 0
            END,
            2
        ) AS utilization_pct,

        GREATEST(
            COALESCE(SUM(rd.planned_hours), 0)
            - rc.available_hours,
            0
        ) AS overallocation_hours

    FROM resource_capacity rc

    LEFT JOIN resource_demand rd
      ON rd.resource_id = rc.resource_id
     AND rd.week_start_date = rc.week_start_date

    WHERE rc.resource_id = $1
      AND rc.week_start_date = $2

    GROUP BY
        rc.resource_id,
        rc.week_start_date,
        rc.available_hours
),

classified AS (
    SELECT
        u.*,

        CASE
            WHEN u.utilization_pct >= 120 THEN 'Critical'
            WHEN u.utilization_pct >= 100 THEN 'High'
            WHEN u.utilization_pct >= 85 THEN 'Warning'
            ELSE 'Normal'
        END AS severity

    FROM utilization u
)

INSERT INTO capacity_conflicts (
    resource_id,
    week_start_date,
    conflict_type,
    utilization_pct,
    overallocation_hours,
    severity,
    status
)

SELECT
    resource_id,
    week_start_date,
    'RESOURCE_OVERALLOCATION',
    utilization_pct,
    overallocation_hours,
    severity,
    'Open'

FROM classified

WHERE utilization_pct >= 100

ON CONFLICT (
    resource_id,
    week_start_date,
    conflict_type
)

DO UPDATE SET
    utilization_pct = EXCLUDED.utilization_pct,
    overallocation_hours = EXCLUDED.overallocation_hours,
    severity = EXCLUDED.severity,
    status = 'Open'

RETURNING *;
